title: Shifted Tate units and normalized integral scalar comparison data
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, finite extensions $E,F/\mathbf Q_\ell$ in one universe, an algebra map $\iota:E\to F$ over $\mathbf Q_\ell$, their valuation rings and chosen uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme $S$ in that universe with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_{E,S}=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,S}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $U_{E,S}=R_{E,S}[0]$ [def-weil-constant-coefficient-objects], and let $C_{F/E,S}=(-)\otimes^L_{R_{E,S}}R_{F,S}$ be ordinary derived scalar extension [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Write $\chi:C_{F/E,S}\to C^{\mathrm{tower}}_{F/E,S}$ for the specified comparison with strict-tower scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension, lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. These definitions name the following existing constructions, and assert no domain-preservation or coefficient-cocycle theorem.

1. Given a finite-field datum $D$ of characteristic $p$ and $\ell\ne p$ as in [def-pur-conventions], define $u_{F/E,S}:C_{F/E,S}U_{E,S}\xrightarrow{\sim}U_{F,S}$ to be $\chi_{U_{E,S}}$ followed by the normalized strict coefficient-unit isomorphism of [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. This is ordinary coefficient multiplication with its fixed quotient-coordinate and K-flat normalization. For $n\in\mathbf Z$, define $s_{F/E,n}:C_{F/E,S}(-[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}(C_{F/E,S}(-))[n]$ by the ordinary derived commutation-with-shift structure selected with its termwise-tensor and universal-counit normalization in [lem-weil-point-completed-scalar-shift]. Define the coefficient-base inclusion $\mathbf Q_\ell^{\uparrow}\to E$ by $x\mapsto\operatorname{algebraMap}(\mathbf Q_\ell,E)(x.\mathrm{down})$, where $\mathbf Q_\ell^{\uparrow}$ is its canonical universe lift.

2. Fix a purity setting $P$ [def-pur-conventions], hence $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and $\ell\ne p$, and a $k$-scheme $S$ (without finite-type, separatedness or nonemptiness requirements for these definitions). Define the residue-field inverse of $\ell$ at every $x\in S$ by mapping its fixed stalk unit through the residue homomorphism. With the existing Tate twisting functor $(-)(m)$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed], define $T_{E,S,d}=U_{E,S}(d)[2d]$ for $d\in\mathbf N$. Let $\beta_{F/E,M}:C_{F/E,S}(M(d))\xrightarrow{\sim}(C_{F/E,S}M)(d)$ be the fixed ordinary twist comparison of [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar]. Its value on the unit uses the existing integral constant constructible object of [def-weil-constant-weil-structure]. Define
$$q_{F/E,S,d}=(u_{F/E,S}(d)\circ\beta_{F/E,U_{E,S}})[2d]\circ s_{F/E,U_{E,S}(d),2d}:C_{F/E,S}T_{E,S,d}\xrightarrow{\sim}T_{F,S,d}.$$
Define the predicate $\operatorname{UnitDomain}(E,S,d)$ to be the conjunction that $U_{E,S}$ and $T_{E,S,d}$ belong to the derived-complete integral constructible finite-Tor category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and that every positive derived reduction [def-weil-integral-derived-reduction] of $U_{E,S}$ has containing Tor interval $[0,0]$, while every positive derived reduction of $T_{E,S,d}$ has containing Tor interval $[-2d,-2d]$. The predicate is only defined here; its truth and the identity, tower and shift coherence assertions are separate theorems.
